citationText: The Multilingual Internet Names Consortium, http://www.minc.org/ has been an early advocate for the importance of expansion of DNS names to accommodate non-ASCII characters. Some of their specific proposals, while helping people to understand the problems better, were not compatible with the design of the DNS.
